text:
jess_sales: GigaHealth asked for a one-page preflight checklist before we schedule their Private POC next week. Need a concise list we can send to their infra team. Quick please.
ankit_se: I'll draft. Key items: GPU drivers & CUDA, kernel modules, container runtime, k8s reachable, image pull strategy, installer token delivery. Keep it checklist-y.
rachel_fieldops: They have mixed hardware: 2x A100 80GB + 4x T4. They plan to carve A100 with MIG for tenant isolation. Need guidance on MIG profiles we support.
sam_eng: We support MIG on A100. Recommend driver >=525 and nvidia-operator approach if they want automatic driver & toolkit lifecycle. If they prefer manual: ensure nvidia-driver + nvidia-container-toolkit installed.
ankit_se: Short commands for them to run and paste outputs (one-liners):
```
# GPU summary
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,driver_version,mig.mode.current --format=csv
# Kernel & modules
uname -r; lsmod | grep nvidia || true
# Check CUDA runtime (if installed)
nvcc --version || echo "no nvcc"
# Container runtime
containerd --version || docker --version
# K8s
kubectl get nodes -o wide
```
rachel_fieldops: Add: `kubectl get pods -n kube-system` and `kubectl get cs` maybe. Also request kube-apiserver reachability from install host: `curl -k https://<kube-apiserver>:6443/healthz`
security_pep: For us: they must provide network egress allowlist to only these FQDNs/IPs. Also confirm whether logs are allowed to leave cluster. They previously indicated no PII or PHI may be sent.
jess_sales: They prefer an offline install (air-gapped) for the POC. How do we deliver images & manifests?
sam_eng: We can produce an offline bundle (tar.gz) with images and signed manifests. They need a local registry mirror URL (e.g., mirror.local/gigahealth/redwood) and the registry cert if TLS terminated. If they want pull-through caching instead, we'll provide registry hostnames/IPs to allow outbound to.
ankit_se: Edge-case notes for their infra team (copy-paste friendly):
- cgroup: prefer cgroup v2; if v1, enable systemd cgroup driver and set kubelet to use it.
- iptables vs nft: kube-proxy compatibility; if nft is enforced provide iptables-nftshim.
- SELinux: if running Enforcing, disable for POC or run our compatibility test.
- swap: must be disabled.
- CRI sockets: containerd default /run/containerd/containerd.sock or Docker's dockershim proxy.

rachel_fieldops: MIG specifics: tell them to list MIG devices: `nvidia-smi mig -l` and confirm MIG is enabled with `nvidia-smi -q | grep -i mig`. Recommend sizes: for A100 80GB use 7g.40gb for heavy inference or 1g.5gb for small. We'll adapt by model profile during onboarding.
security_pep: KMS/HSM: they use AWS CloudHSM in their VPC. For Private we support customer KMS via mTLS to their HSM gateway. Need contact, IP, and CA bundle. Also require MFA enforced on admin accounts.
jess_sales: POC API/access question: can we grant them a scoped API key and a time-limited installer token? Also pricing note: they asked if Dedicated pricing can be applied during POC.
ankit_se: For access: yes — create scoped API key (eval-gigahc) expiring 14d, and a one-time install token for control plane handshake. Pricing: POC discounts are case-by-case; sales can offer trial credits but Dedicated contracts require minimum commit. You can propose a short term trial on hosted credits.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: REDWOOD-INTL-4599. Attach the offline bundle request form to this ticket.
sam_eng: Additional checks for the install run (we'll need before booking):
- sudo user + ability to reboot nodes within the window
- kube-admin kubeconfig with cluster-admin for install namespace or install SA kubeconfig
- local registry mirror reachable from all nodes
- free disk space on nodes (\u2265 40GB) and /var/lib/containerd space

rachel_fieldops: If they have mixed driver versions across the cluster we may force node-level taints to schedule workload appropriately. Also confirm node labelling strategy for GPU types: e.g., `gpu-type=a100`
ankit_se: One more: ask them to run `docker info --format '{{json .Runtimes}}' || true` to show if nvidia runtime configured. If not present, they need nvidia-container-toolkit installed and daemon updated.
security_pep: Send them our minimal security checklist: SSO enforced, RBAC policies for admin accounts, audit log retention (30d default) and which namespaces exclude logs. They must sign an NDA addendum for HSM access.
jess_sales: I'll send this condensed checklist now. Please review quickly for anything missing.
sam_eng: Looks good. Optional: we can also offer a test upgrade run (driver bump) during POC if they allow maintenance window.
rachel_fieldops: Once they return the checklist with outputs we can slot a remote install (2h) and a follow-up tuning session (30-60m).
jess_sales: Thanks all. I'll ping once I have their answers. :white_check_mark:
